chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al-A'ala ibn Razin, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'By My Honour, and My Majesty, and My Magnificence, and My Glory, and the loftiness of My Exaltedness! No believing servant would prefer My desires over his own desires in anything from the matters of the world, except that I shall make richness to be in his soul, and concern him regarding his Hereafter, and I shall guarantee the skies and the earth for his sustenance, and I shall be for him behind the trade of every trader.'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and material rewards for a believer who prioritizes God's will over their own desires?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith qudsi from al-Kafi underscores the concept of 'Ghina' (spiritual self-sufficiency) as a divine reward for prioritizing God's will over worldly desires. It highlights the metaphysical guarantee of rizq (sustenance) by the cosmos, positioning God as the ultimate guarantor of the believer's spiritual 'trade,' thereby linking asceticism with divine provision.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said: “By My<sup>azwj</sup> Honour, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Majesty, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Magnificence, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Glory, and the Loftiness of My<sup>azwj</sup> Exaltedness! No believing servant would prefer My<sup>azwj</sup> Desires over his own desires with regards to anything from the matters of the world, except that I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Make richness to be in his soul, and Concern him regarding his Hereafter, and the skies and the earth would guarantee his sustenance, and I<sup>azwj</sup> would be for him behind a trade with every trader’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from ibn Sinan from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, has said, ‘I Swear by My Majesty, My Glory, My Greatness, Beauty and Height of My Highness, if anyone of My servant acts as I wish instead of his own wish in anything of worldly matters I will make him feel rich in his soul and concentrate on his affairs of the next life. I guarantee to provide his sustenance from the heavens and earth, and I will be for him (to support) in all of his dealings with each and every merchant.’”
